newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling edges up against the dollar.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling edges up against the dollar.

text.p: The Kenyan shilling edged upwards against the dollar on Thursday, boosted by earnings from cofee exports, dealers said.
Kenya's central bank posted a shilling mean rate of 53.46 against the dollar compared to 53.47 on Wednesday.
Against the pound, the shilling was posted at a mean rate of 87.56 from 87.30.
"The shilling is still gaining. There are good inflows from coffee exporters," one dealer said.
The money market remained slightly tight with overnight rates quoted at 14-15 percent.
